gothic-coffin-makeup-brush-holder-stl-3d.d: A brush holder shaped like a little coffin for a vanity with a dark streak. It keeps tools upright and makes the daily routine feel like a ritual.

gothic-combat-boot-makeup-brush-holder.d: A laced boot that cradles brushes with a rebellious edge. It is equal parts organizer and attitude for the gothic desk.

vintage-makeup-brush-holder-stl-rococo-2.d: A brush holder with ornate vintage curves for a romantic, old-world vanity. The scrollwork prints clean and looks far dearer than it is.

elegant-rococo-makeup-brush-holder-stl.d: A refined rococo profile that turns a brush jar into a decor piece. It suits moody, candle-lit bathrooms and dressing tables.

gothic-makeup-brush-holder-cathedral.d: A brush holder with arched, cathedral-like detailing for a solemn, grand feel. It is architecture for the vanity in miniature.

gothic-jewelry-trinket-dish-stl.d: A shadowed dish that catches rings and earrings with ornate edges. It is a small, dramatic rest for the things you never want to lose.

art-nouveau-makeup-brush-holder-stl.d: A brush holder with flowing, nature-inspired lines from the art nouveau tradition. It softens the gothic lean with elegant, organic curves.

gothic-vanity-decor-shelf-stl.d: A lace-edged shelf that turns trinkets into a small altar of detail. Style it with rings and tiny treasures for a romantic, slightly gothic finishing touch.
